pairs.l: 3 — which was near a railway line?
10 — which required a lot of work?
12 — where it was difficult to study?

r1.exp: 1=F (Fiona: 'felt miserable there and needed company'). 2=C (Caleb: 'no way I could keep paying the rent so I left both the apartment and university'). 3=F (Fiona: 'the passing trains'). 4=D (Doris: friend of father's 'let me stay there to look after it'). 5=C (Caleb: 'close to my faculty building, so I didn't lose time travelling'). 6=F (Fiona: 'gangs hanging around outside with their ghetto blasters blaring'). 7=E (Edgar: 'I felt closed in, like I couldn't breathe'). 8=C (Caleb: 'everything was new, the bathroom, the kitchen'). 9=B (Bella: 'when I visited again a couple of years ago, it was no longer there!'). 10=B (Bella: 'in a terrible condition, no-one had invested in it for years'). 11=E (Edgar: 'neighbours, a retired couple, kept banging on the walls'). 12=E (Edgar: 'I desperately needed somewhere where I could have some space and get some work done').

r13.exp: 'Mum STILL BLAMES THIS [the neighbourhood, unemployment rate] for everything' = majka krivi krajnje siromaštvo = A.

r14.exp: 'I was just a PETRIFIED kid' = prestrašen, uplašen = A (Afraid). 'Petrified' = ukočen od straha.

r15.exp: 'Initially, I OBSESSIVELY WORKED OUT. I was able to do hundreds of SIT-UPS.' = puno vježbao = D.

r16.exp: 'Couldn't take up university position because record prevented obtaining a visa — A BITTER DISAPPOINTMENT, EVEN MORE SO THAN remaining single' = ograničenje u karijeri = B.

r17.exp: 'Pay my DEBT TO THE SOCIETY that I wronged' = vraća društvu što je uzeo = C (give something back).

r18.exp: 'To a certain extent true that prison doesn't work, NEVERTHELESS it gave me a SECOND CHANCE' = ovisi o tebi što ćeš napraviti s prigodom = C (what you make of it).

r19.exp: 'Sons of hunters became eco-tour guides. (19)___. He explained that people know nature and can catch animals by hand.' → G: They catch the most unique animals for tourists and release them unharmed. Opisuje što eco-vodiči rade.

r20.exp: 'Only one highly developed sense — amazing vision. (20)___. How could we come close enough?' → C: As a result, they are extremely sensitive to movement. Izvrsni vid = osjetljivi na pokret.

r21.exp: 'We sighted a large alligator on a river bank. (21)___. With a long stick, Paulo started to poke around in the water.' → H: As usual, it dived instantly at our approach. Aligator pobjegao → Paulo ga traži štapom.

r22.exp: Samostalni paragraf između pokušaja — (22)___. → F: It would take a few more encounters for me to lose my fear. Objašnjava da se strah nije odmah izgubio.

r23.exp: 'Stopped in front of a large pool of water. (23)___. Barefoot, he stepped into the mixture.' → B: Before attempting to cross it, Paulo went to check its depth. Paulo prvo provjeri dubinu ribnjaka.

r24.exp: 'Purpose was to fight my fear. (24)___. After a few seconds it looked so harmless.' → E: So I continued to hold it in my hands. Nastavio držati aligator = borio se sa strahom.

r25.exp: 'One important KEY to success' — fiksna kolokacija: the key to success = ključ uspjeha.

r27.exp: 'Things BEYOND your control' — fiksna kolokacija: beyond your control = izvan tvoje kontrole.

r28.exp: 'OTHER people's opinions' — 'other' uz množinu imenice (other people = drugi ljudi). 'Another' uz jedninu.

r29.exp: 'Afraid OF saying something stupid' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: be afraid of + gerund.

r30.exp: 'SPEAK up when talking to people' — frazalni glagol: speak up = govoriti glasnije/odlučnije.

r31.exp: 'May take some TIME' — fiksna kolokacija: take time (trajati, trebati vremena). 'A period of time' je i moguće, ali 'some time' je najprirodnija fraza.

r32.exp: 'HOWEVER low their level of belief might be' — 'however' + adj/adv za koncesivnu surečenicu: however + pridjev = ma koliko... (no matter how).

r33.exp: 'When EVERYONE/EVERYBODY speaks English nowadays' — neodređena zamjenica za sve ljude.

r34.exp: 'Dropped IN favour of modern authors' — fiksna kolokacija: in favour of = u korist (nečega).

r35.exp: 'Puts OUT/TOGETHER poetry anthologies' — frazalni glagol: put out/together = objaviti, sastaviti (antologiju).

r36.exp: 'Don't dare teach it, HAVING learned very little about it themselves' — perfektni participni prilog: having + past participle = jer su naučili malo.

r37.exp: 'Disappear FROM the classroom' — prijedlog 'from' uz 'disappear from' (nestati iz).

r38.exp: 'Is UNDER way' — fiksni izraz: be under way = biti u tijeku.

r39.exp: 'IT seems that...' — bezlična konstrukcija: it seems that = čini se da.

r40.exp: 'Missing OUT on an important experience' — frazalni glagol: miss out on = propustiti, izgubiti priliku za.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA odgovornost prestaje s 18: punoljetnost, pravna neovisnost, pravo na vlastite odluke. ZA odgovornost ne prestaje nikad: roditeljska ljubav, financijska podrška, životno iskustvo. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
